title: Utility Line Protection Plans Seasonal Calendar: Lawn Season Rates

# Seasonal Calendar: Lawn Season Rates

Seasonal schedule for lawn restoration under the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans.

## Rule

A property is in the frost territory when it lies in a state whose plumbing code sets a design frost depth of at least 36 inches for buried water lines across most of the state, because there the soil over a service line freezes deep enough in winter that excavation must break frozen ground: Alaska, Colorado, Connecticut, Illinois, Iowa, Maine, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Montana, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New York, North Dakota, Rhode Island, South Dakota, Vermont, Wisconsin and Wyoming. The state is read from the first three digits of the ZIP code recorded for the property on the plan: 005, 010 through 069, 100 through 149, 480 through 629, 680 through 693, 800 through 831 and 995 through 999 are the frost territory, and every other ZIP code is outside it. Lawn season rate: on a property in the frost territory, a request placed in December, January, February or March takes the dormant-season lawn rate, because the yard is sodded or covered with an erosion blanket now and overseeded in spring, and a request placed in November or April takes the late-season lawn rate, for heavier straw cover on seed that germinates slowly; a request on a property outside the frost territory, or placed in any other month, takes a lawn season rate of one. The lawn season rate multiplies the plan's landscaping restoration allowance in the lawn restoration figure.

## Calendar

| Month of the request date | Property in the frost territory | Property outside the frost territory |
|---|---|---|
| December, January, February, March | 1.3 (dormant season) | 1 |
| November, April | 1.15 (late season) | 1 |
| May through October | 1 | 1 |

## The frost territory by ZIP code

| First three digits of the ZIP code recorded for the property on the plan | Frost territory |
|---|---|
| 005 | yes |
| 010 through 069 | yes |
| 100 through 149 | yes |
| 480 through 629 | yes |
| 680 through 693 | yes |
| 800 through 831 | yes |
| 995 through 999 | yes |
| every other first three digits | no |

The first three digits are read with any leading zeros: a ZIP code of 00501 begins 005, and one of 01002 begins 010.

*Boundary readings of the ranges (hypothetical ZIP codes):* 00599 is inside and 00601 outside; 06999 inside and 07001 outside; 14999 inside and 15001 outside; 47999 outside and 48001 inside; 62999 inside and 63001 outside; 67999 outside and 68001 inside; 69399 inside and 69401 outside; 79999 outside and 80001 inside; 83199 inside and 83201 outside; 99499 outside and 99501 inside.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical requests)

- Property ZIP code 80202: placed 31 October, 1; placed 1 November, 1.15; placed 1 December, 1.3; placed 1 April, 1.15; placed 1 May, 1.
- Property ZIP code 84101, request placed in January: 1, the property being outside the frost territory.

## Hypothetical example

A request placed in January on a property in the frost territory, with an allowance of $250.00 assumed: $250.00 multiplied by 1.3 is $325.00.
